name: Zao
source: Senior student at Shinjuku Academy and the President of the Mountaineering Club. Zao is always looking for a new member to join his team in surveying various mountains across Tokyo that appear due to the Overworld Phenomenon. Make sure to never shout out the word "mountain" if you do not want to join his escapade!
